definitionZh: :popover-open CSS伪类代表显示状态下的一个Popover API元素(即一个带有popover属性). 只能当弹出元素被显示时,才能使用它来应用样式 。
sourceDefinition: The :popover-open CSS pseudo-class represents a Popover API element (i.e., one with a popover attribute) that is in the showing state. You can use this to apply style to popover elements only when they are shown.
